source.title: How to Hsin for Dummies - Wuthering Waves

profile.skill_priority_note: Resonance Skill is levelled last: very minimal scaling.

resonance_modes.note: Player-selected in game. Changes the rotation, so the bot needs to be told which one is set.

electro_flare.inherent_1: Any resonator applying Electro Flare grants Hsin +50% Electro DMG bonus, stacks x2. With Electro Rover, both gain a further +20% Electro DMG bonus.
electro_flare.gimmick: Enemies never lose Electro Flare stacks. Electro Rage stacks convert into 'Heart of Thunder' (max 100). Resonance Skill triggers the Electro Flare damage. At >=50 Heart of Thunder stacks it also inflicts Stagnation.

unison.inherent_1: When she triggers another Unison character, +50% ATK for 8s.
unison.mechanic: Every Hsin intro primes Unison. After the FIRST Liberation she gains Unison for 5s; outro within that window to the next Unison character to fire the Unison Response. Coming back in she gets the enhanced intro 'Manifold Unison'.
unison.unison_boon: 3% DMG increase per stack for resonators in Unison with each other. Inherent Skill 2 raises max stacks by 1; S6 raises it by another 1.
unison.outro_replacement: Unison is consumed by the outro INSTEAD of Concerto, so Unison characters can intro/outro twice per cycle.

moves.name: Basic Attack combo
moves.notes: 4-hit combo. Must be TAPPED, not held - holding triggers the heavy attack instead.

moves.name: Heavy Attack
moves.notes: Her own heavy attack; it also skips the combo forward to hit 2, so you can continue 2-3-4 afterwards.

moves.name: Midair Heavy (channel)
moves.notes: Channels and drains stamina, ends on its own. Releasing drops into the plunge, which then chains into combo 2-3-4.

moves.name: Resonance Skill - fox form
moves.notes: Base form E is mostly a gimmick: turns into the little fox. Heals HP in the open world and avoids enemy detection; taking damage reverts instantly. Press E or basic attack to revert.

moves.name: Enhanced Heavy #1 (Formshift)
moves.input: hold LMB when the basic-attack icon glows
moves.notes: After this the gauge shows a red symbol in the centre and the FIRST Liberation becomes available.

moves.name: First Liberation
moves.notes: Entering this form starts a diamond timer under the gauge. Pressing Liberation again toggles between base form and this form (gimmick).

moves.name: Enhanced Resonance Skill
moves.input: E when the E icon shines
moves.notes: Fill the bottom bar with basic attacks, or alternate 1 basic + 1 E which fills it much faster. Opens the final 14 second window.

moves.name: Final form window
moves.notes: 4 basic attacks unlock every lock on the gauge (everything turns shiny), then hold basic attack for the last enhanced heavy, then finish with Liberation.

moves.name: Enhanced Heavy #2 (finisher)
moves.input: hold LMB after the 4 unlock hits

moves.name: Big Liberation (finisher)
moves.notes: After her Liberation she keeps coordinated attacks for up to 21 instances while teammates deal damage on field - useful to charge e.g. Jinhsi's forte.

forte_circuit.notes: Both enhanced heavy attacks share a 24s cooldown on their damage bonus. It is designed around rotating the whole team, so a correct rotation never notices it.

outro: Damage plus 20% all-type DMG amp, or 20% Electro DMG amp while in Electro Flare mode.

steps.note: Alternating 1 basic + 1 E fills the bottom bar immediately.

unison.label: Unison rotation (two visits)
unison.note: Intro -> basic -> heavy -> Liberation never changes. Unison adds one extra basic after intro and splits the rotation across two visits.

pass_1.note: One EXTRA basic vs Electro Flare.
Must happen within the 5s Unison window to fire the Unison Response.

pass_2.note: Skips the basic/E filler that Electro Flare does.

unison.team_order: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1 (e.g. Shorekeeper, Jinhsi, Hsin, Jinhsi, Hsin, Shorekeeper)

main_stats.cost_4: CRIT DMG or CRIT Rate (keep roughly 1:2 crit rate to crit dmg)

build.energy_regen: at least 125% for a smooth rotation

weapons.name: Blooming Jadehaven
weapons.note: Signature. All-attribute DMG bonus, Resonance Skill DMG amp, ignores DEF, +30% Electro Flare DMG taken. A clear step above everything else.

build.weapon_note: Anything below the top three is considered relatively weak.

sequences.S1: Anti-interruption: 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, each blocks one interruption and cuts damage taken by 60%. Intro skill DMG +15%, and Unison Boon adds +10% intro multiplier up to 4 stacks. If Heart of Thunder is below 50 at combat start it is set to 50, so Resonance Skill immediately applies Stagnation.
sequences.S2: ~15% damage. On entering combat all cooldowns reset and 100 points of the first gauge are restored, so you can immediately enhanced-heavy into the first Liberation. Enhanced heavy attack damage +60%.
sequences.S3: ~25% damage. Big Liberation DMG +70%. In Unison, big Liberation CRIT DMG +20% per Unison Boon stack (up to 4 = +60%). In Electro Flare, the big Liberation triggers one extra Electro Flare instance at a 1500% multiplier.
sequences.S4: All resonators gain 20% all-attribute DMG bonus.
sequences.S5: Death insurance: restores to 100% max HP and grants damage immunity, once every 10 minutes.
sequences.S6: ~50-60% damage. Enemies take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin and she ignores 20% DEF with Resonance Skill. Max Unison Boon stacks +1, and any resonator triggering a Unison Response grants every resonator an extra boon stack. In Electro Flare, Electro Flare DMG can now crit at a fixed 80% crit rate / 230% crit DMG.
sequences.pull_recommendation: S0R1 first (one copy plus the signature weapon). After that S1-S3, then jump to S6.

teams.label: Unison team (currently available)
teams.note: Set Hsin's resonance mode to Unison. Rotation order is 1-2-3-2-3-1.

teams.label: Electro Flare team
teams.note: Set Hsin's resonance mode to Electro Flare. Electro Rover is the Flare applicator; Buling (Douling) is the budget third, Suisui/Chisa raise the Flare stack ceiling.

automation_mapping.note: How the guide maps onto detectors the bot already has. Both of Hsin's visual cues are generic ok-ww features that are already annotated, so no new templates are required for the rotation itself.
automation_mapping.mouse_forte: The 'basic attack is glowing' cue. Gates both enhanced heavy attacks.
automation_mapping.e_forte: The 'E skill is shining' cue. Gates the enhanced Resonance Skill.
automation_mapping.liberation: Standard liberation availability check covers both the first and the big Liberation.
unresolved: No dedicated template distinguishes Unison form from Electro Flare form on the HUD, so the mode is a user config flag ('Hsin Unison Mode') rather than a detection.
The diamond timer under the gauge and the red centre symbol are not yet annotated; they would let the bot measure the first-Liberation window instead of using a timeout.

anchor_meaning.chapter_exact: Taken verbatim from the author's chapter list in the video description - exact.
anchor_meaning.interpolated: Estimated by locating the spoken cue inside its chapter and interpolating by word position between the two surrounding exact chapter anchors. Expect a few seconds of drift, so capture a window and pick the best frame.
